description: Mapa 09 - Ações Prioritárias no Transporte Público Coletivo (Linhas) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Nos termos do Plano Diretor Estratégico - Revisão Intermediária (Lei nº 17.975/23), Mapa 9, foram retratadas as ações prioritárias para as Linhas do Sistema de Transporte Público Coletivo. Estão representados os modais existentes e os propostos na legislação. Esta camada reproduz uma parte dos dados do Mapa 9 desta lei. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Ambiente construído, Planejamento urbano, Plano Diretor, planningCadastre. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
